verdict.rationale: Make's docs reference dedicated error-handling pages and error handlers for scenarios, supporting the ability to diagnose and define error-handling paths, but the evidence pack lacks detail on configuring dedicated error/fallback routes or on notification mechanisms upon run failure. missing for 10: specifics on error-handler routes (e.g., Break, Resume, Rollback, Ignore), configuration of notification/alerting on failure, and any hands-on or independent verification of these features working as described.
